analytics.name: Analytic 1737
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Execution Guardrails from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App performs burst of environmental check APIs (Build properties, TelephonyManager IMSI, PackageManager security-tool query) at cold launch before user interaction — multi-category environment fingerprint is the guardrail setup]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Default 30s at cold launch. Environmental checks at launch before user interaction are guardrail setup. Post-interaction checks may be feature-driven.
Behavioral fork detection requires telemetry across multiple device populations (enrolled vs unenrolled). Without population comparison, single-device detection is Low confidence.
